gen-pirata-one-mulish: Mulish draws every stroke at a single smooth thickness, with open-mouthed curves and a generous lowercase body. Pirata One, gothic and tightly packed, gives it something to push against.
gen-pirata-one-poppins: Poppins moves in loose, round curves with no thick-thin flicker. Over many lines it feels smooth and sturdy, while Pirata One's gothic heading stays dense and commanding above it.
gen-pirata-one-roboto-slab: Gothic letters packed nose to tail, with a tall lowercase, make Pirata One unmistakable. Roboto Slab sits under it, structured and slab-serif, its middle zone dominating each line and giving the heading some air to breathe.
gen-pirata-one-rubik: Gothic and dense, with a tall lowercase. Rubik is the soft counterpart, a sans-serif whose big, round letters sit loosely beside Pirata One's tight, commanding ones.
gen-rammetto-one-bitter: Bitter is a slab-serif with a very large lowercase eye and an s you can see through. Rammetto One, playful and hairline-free, gives that grounded body a cheerful, chunky voice to answer to.
gen-rammetto-one-inter: Inter fills its lines with big, breathing counters and a smooth, tube-like look. And Rammetto One's tall, swelling-free playfulness gives that sans body a lively, inviting face.
gen-rammetto-one-poppins: Tall lowercase pressed close to the capitals, with no calligraphic swell, defines Rammetto One. And Poppins, a modern sans-serif with loose, rope-like curves, gives that playfulness plenty of room to land.
gen-titan-one-mulish: Chunky, bright and a bit cheeky. Titan One's towering midzone and brush-lifted curve ends sit above Mulish, a sans with open apertures and no stroke modulation, which keeps the whole thing friendly.
gen-titan-one-poppins: Bold and playful describes Titan One, whose single-width strokes and towering midzone make it a loud, rounded headline voice. Poppins handles the quieter work, with loose curves and sturdy lowercase that carry text without any thick-thin flicker.
gen-unifrakturmaguntia-bitter: Bitter, a slab-serif with a very large lowercase eye and an open s, grounds the pairing in dependable, readable text. UnifrakturMaguntia adds a lofty, clustered gothic look.
